prompt: Never ___ I seen such a beautiful sunset.
explanation: Olumsuz zarflar (never, rarely, hardly) cümle başına gelince özne-yardımcı fiil yer değiştirir: Never have I seen…

prompt: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the documents.
explanation: « Not only » cümle başında devrik yapı ister: not only was he late…

prompt: Hardly had she arrived ___ the phone rang.
explanation: « Hardly … when » ve « No sooner … than » ikilileri: hardly had she arrived when…

prompt: Rarely ___ such dedication.
explanation: « Rarely » başa gelince yardımcı fiil gerekir ve devrik olur: rarely do we see.

prompt: No sooner had he left when it started to rain.
explanation: « No sooner » ile « than » kullanılır (« hardly » ile « when » kullanılır): no sooner had he left than…

prompt: Only after the meeting ___ I realise my mistake.
explanation: « Only after/when/then » ile başlayan cümlede yardımcı fiil öne geçer: only after the meeting did I realise.

prompt: It was Maria ___ broke the window.
explanation: Vurgulu cümle: It was + vurgulanan öğe + who/that. Kişide who tercih edilir.

prompt: ___ I need is a good night’s sleep.
explanation: « What … is » yapısıyla “ihtiyacım olan şey” vurgulanır.

prompt: It is on Friday ___ the exam takes place.
explanation: Zaman ve yer vurgusunda « that » kullanılır: it is on Friday that…

prompt: What he did ___ to apologise.
explanation: « What he did was (to) apologise »: wh-cleft’te be fiili gelir.

prompt: The reason ___ I called is to invite you.
explanation: « The reason why/that … is to… » nedeni vurgular.

prompt: It was yesterday what I met her.
explanation: Vurgulu cümlede « what » değil « that » gelir: it was yesterday that I met her.

prompt: If I had studied medicine, I ___ a doctor now.
explanation: Karma şart: geçmişteki koşul (past perfect) → şimdiki sonuç (would + mastar).

prompt: If she weren’t so shy, she ___ (join) the team last year.
explanation: Karma şart: şimdiki özellik (past simple) → geçmişteki sonuç (would have + V3).

prompt: If he ___ the keys, he would be inside now.
explanation: Geçmişteki koşul past perfect ile kurulur: if he had taken the keys.

prompt: If I ___ (be) taller, I would have become a basketball player.
explanation: Şimdiki / kalıcı durum past simple ile: if I were taller.

prompt: If I would have known, I'd have told you.
explanation: « If » cümlesinde would kullanılmaz: if I had known.

prompt: I wouldn’t be so tired now if I ___ to bed earlier last night.
explanation: Dün gece (geçmiş) → şimdiki sonuç: past perfect + would.

prompt: I suggest that he ___ the doctor.
explanation: Suggest, insist, demand, recommend + that sonrası yalın fiil (subjunctive) gelir: he see.

prompt: It is essential that every student ___ (be) on time.
explanation: « It is essential/vital/important that » sonrası yalın fiil: be.

prompt: If I ___ you, I’d apologise.
explanation: « If I were you » kalıp sözdür; were (subjunctive) kullanılır.

prompt: She insisted that he ___ (olumsuz) leave early.
explanation: Subjunctive olumsuzu « not + yalın fiil »: that he not leave.

prompt: I wish I ___ (know) the answer.
explanation: Şimdiki zamandaki gerçek dışı dilek: wish + past simple → knew.

prompt: The manager demanded that she submits the report.
explanation: Demand that sonrasında üçüncü tekil -s eklenmez: that she submit.

prompt: ___ the door, she heard a noise.
explanation: Aynı özneli eş zamanlı iki eylem: -ing ortaç yan cümlesi (Opening the door, she…).

prompt: ___ (finish) his homework, Tom went out to play.
explanation: Önce biten eylem « having + V3 »: Having finished his homework…

prompt: The letters ___ yesterday haven’t arrived.
explanation: Edilgen anlam: V3 ortaç: the letters sent yesterday (= which were sent).

prompt: ___ tired, she went to bed early.
explanation: Neden bildiren -ing ortaç: Feeling tired, she went to bed early.

prompt: Not ___ (know) what to say, he stayed silent.
explanation: Olumsuz ortaç « not + -ing »: not knowing what to say…

prompt: ___ by the noise, the baby woke up.
explanation: Edilgen anlamlı V3 ortaç: Woken by the noise, the baby…

prompt: I enjoy ___ in the garden.
explanation: Enjoy, avoid, finish, mind… + -ing alır.

prompt: She decided ___ abroad.
explanation: Decide, hope, plan, refuse… + to-infinitive alır.

prompt: I remember ___ (lock) the door, so it must be somewhere inside.
explanation: Remember + -ing: yapılmış olanı hatırlamak. Remember + to yapılması gerekeni hatırlamaktır.

prompt: Remember ___ the milk on your way home.
explanation: Remember + to-infinitive: yapılması gereken şeyi unutmamak.

prompt: He stopped ___ (smoke) five years ago.
explanation: Stop + -ing: bir eylemi bırakmak. Stop + to: bir eylemi yapmak için durmak.

prompt: I look forward to see you soon.
explanation: « Look forward to »’daki to bir edattır; ardından -ing gelir: look forward to seeing.
